comment: Composite indexes Firestore can't infer. Deploy with:
Everything else in this codebase sorts in memory precisely to avoid needing
indexes; the entries here exist where reading a whole collection would cost
a document read per stored row on every page load.

indexes.comment: Inbox: newest-N received mail. Without this, GET /api/emails/messages reads EVERY message a provider has ever received, on every load and every live refresh.
